dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: No matter the mission, we must ensure that we're fully prepared before setting out...

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: I'm a rank-and-file Ratnik in charge of menial tasks and admin work. You can also say I'm the one who handles visitors around here.

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: Please let me know if there's any danger you'd like us Lightkeepers to handle for you. I'll arrange for someone to take care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need a hand with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: Oh, thanks for offering. However, I won't need your help, as all I have are minor, routine tasks to make sure nothing goes wrong at my station.

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: But if you really would like to help... Let me think... Maybe you can head over to Illuga's. You know, the leader of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles.

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: Young people are always in such a hurry to take responsibility for — and manage — everything themselves. But little do they know that over time... Sorry, I’m just rambling now. Anyway, you should head over there — they probably could use a helping hand or two.

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: Mmm. No matter where you are, always remember that safety comes first.
